system.description: This power is similar to the Auspex power of Psychic Projection, but your spirit remains within the physical realm. Your body remains in one place while the spirit travels around. You can be trapped inside fetishes when in this state, and can potentially be controlled by any spirit power. Mental Disciplines that do not require touch are available for use while in this state, except Necromancy or any other Spirit Thaumaturgy; any power requiring physical contact or that manipulates the physical body is unavailable. Your spirit is visible to those around you unless Obfuscate is being used. To activate this power requires the expenditure of one Willpower Trait. While in this form your spirit is immune to physical harm but is affected by sunlight and wards as normal.
